{{Otheruses|Atlas}}
'''''Janessa{{'s}} Atlas''''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] mapping system enhancement to [[Astrography|astrographic]] databases during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Considered highly useful by independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], this supplement provided local information on points of interest and anomalies. It also gave warnings and advisories regarding the safety of various locations, especially concerning factional and [[Politics/Legends|political]] information, for [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]], among others.
